Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics portion of this study is a descriptive protein inventory and absolute quantification (copy number determination) of human sperm. While the paper describes many functional perturbations (CO2, pH shifts, amiloride) using fluorometry and patch-clamp, these were not the variables used to differentiate the mass spectrometry samples. The MS was used to identify which proteins are present or absent in the cells. Therefore, it is classified as un-classified as there is no differential treatment axis for the proteomics data itself, other than a positive control using HEK293 cells.
